note: Analytical inputs per Signal Library signal, recorded by input, not by provider (price is 'price' whether it comes from Yahoo or Coinalyze). Disjoint root sets mean separate sources only, not statistical independence. 'price' = OHLC prices; 'volume' = candle volume; 'derivatives' = Coinalyze open interest, funding, long/short and liquidations. Version 2 adds 'price' to positioning.oi_price (uses price change) and positioning.liquidation_levels (uses the current price). Groups and Sets pin the lineage version they were validated with. Not editable by users.
